articles.title: NVIDIA Expands Commitments With Supply Chain Partners to Support AI Infrastructure Buildout

articles.fullText: News Summary: New agreements with Kinsus and Samsung Electro-Mechanics support additional substrate capacity and expanded production capabilities at existing factories. NVIDIA’s work with Amkor and SPIL expands advanced packaging capacity for current and next-generation accelerated computing platforms. NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and Vera CPUs began volume shipments in the third quarter, leveraging TSMC’s 5nm, 3nm and CoWoS advanced packaging technologies. Foxconn is deepening its collaboration with NVIDIA, drawing on its global production network to support next-generation GPU and networking platforms. NVIDIA today announced expanded commitments with supply chain partners to support sustainable long-term growth, aligning supply and manufacturing capacity with demand for its accelerated computing and AI infrastructure platforms. Working with Amkor Technology, Foxconn, Kinsus Interconnect Technology, Samsung Electro-Mechanics , Siliconware Precision Industries (SPIL) and TSMC, NVIDIA is expanding manufacturing capacity across substrates, advanced packaging, wafer and contract manufacturing to scale production of its current and next-generation accelerated computing platforms. “Our supply chain is a strategic advantage,” said Debora Shoquist, executive vice president of operations at NVIDIA. “Our work with these partners builds on our manufacturing foundation for long-term growth, expanding capacity across components, advanced packaging and system production to deliver the accelerated computing platforms our customers need.” Increasing Substrate Capacity and Production Capabilities NVIDIA is expanding its substrate supply commitments with Kinsus and Samsung Electro-Mechanics, adding manufacturing capacity and improving production capabilities at existing factories. Under a new agreement with NVIDIA, Kinsus plans to expand its advanced ABF package substrate manufacturing capacity dedicated to NVIDIA by more than 3.5x over current levels from its Youth campus in Taoyuan, Taiwan. Production is expected to begin in the second half of 2027, with the additional capacity targeted for the third quarter of 2028. This multiyear agreement builds on the companies’ existing supplier relationship and supports NVIDIA’s long-term supply planning for its accelerated computing platforms. “We believe AI will be one of the most important technology transitions of our lifetime,” said Scott Chen, CEO and president of Kinsus. “After more than a decade of partnership with NVIDIA, we are excited to continue building the future together.” NVIDIA and Samsung Electro-Mechanics have amended their existing substrate supply agreement to improve operational capabilities at existing factories in support of increased production of NVIDIA’s accelerated computing platforms. The amendment builds on the companies’ previously announced multiyear collaboration supporting substrate manufacturing in Sejong and Busan, South Korea, for NVIDIA’s compute and high-speed networking technologies. “By combining our world-class substrate fine-processing technology and high-reliability MLCC technology, we will perfectly fulfill our role as a total solution provider so that NVIDIA’s AI platform can be supplied to the global market on time, with the highest performance and quality,” said Duck-Hyun Chang, CEO of Samsung Electro-Mechanics.   Scaling Advanced Packaging Through Multiyear Agreements NVIDIA’s advanced packaging plans include a new capacity expansion with SPIL and previously announced agreements supporting Amkor’s manufacturing expansion in the U.S. and South Korea. NVIDIA is supporting Amkor’s expansion of advanced packaging capacity in Arizona and South Korea through multiyear agreements announced in July and October 2026, totaling nearly $3 billion. The agreements include prepayments to help Amkor scale manufacturing capacity for NVIDIA’s long-term production needs. “Our agreements with NVIDIA support investments in Arizona and South Korea that will serve multiple generations of AI platforms,” said Kevin Engel, president and CEO of Amkor. “That long-term planning allows us to advance our packaging technologies and add manufacturing capacity as NVIDIA’s production needs grow.” NVIDIA and SPIL are expanding advanced packaging operations in Taiwan under a multiyear agreement supported by multibillion-dollar funding from NVIDIA. The expansion will increase contracted advanced packaging capacity dedicated to NVIDIA by mid-2029. The project includes new production lines with turnkey support spanning bumping, interposer wafer fabrication, assembly and testing. leadArticles.fullText: News Summary: New agreements with Kinsus and Samsung Electro-Mechanics support additional substrate capacity and expanded production capabilities at existing factories. NVIDIA’s work with Amkor and SPIL expands advanced packaging capacity for current and next-generation accelerated computing platforms. NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 and Vera CPUs began volume shipments in the third quarter, leveraging TSMC’s 5nm, 3nm and CoWoS advanced packaging technologies. Foxconn is deepening its collaboration with NVIDIA, drawing on its global production network to support next-generation GPU and networking platforms. NVIDIA today announced expanded commitments with supply chain partners to support sustainable long-term growth, aligning supply and manufacturing capacity with demand for its accelerated computing and AI infrastructure platforms. Working with Amkor Technology, Foxconn, Kinsus Interconnect Technology, Samsung Electro-Mechanics , Siliconware Precision Industries (SPIL) and TSMC, NVIDIA is expanding manufacturing capacity across substrates, advanced packaging, wafer and contract manufacturing to scale production of its current and next-generation accelerated computing platforms. “Our supply chain is a strategic advantage,” said Debora Shoquist, executive vice president of operations at NVIDIA. “Our work with these partners builds on our manufacturing foundation for long-term growth, expanding capacity across components, advanced packaging and system production to deliver the accelerated computing platforms our customers need.” Increasing Substrate Capacity and Production Capabilities NVIDIA is expanding its substrate supply commitments with Kinsus and Samsung Electro-Mechanics, adding manufacturing capacity and improving production capabilities at existing factories. Under a new agreement with NVIDIA, Kinsus plans to expand its advanced ABF package substrate manufacturing capacity dedicated to NVIDIA by more than 3.5x over current levels from its Youth campus in Taoyuan, Taiwan. Production is expected to begin in the second half of 2027, with the additional capacity targeted for the third quarter of 2028. This multiyear agreement builds on the companies’ existing supplier relationship and supports NVIDIA’s long-term supply planning for its accelerated computing platforms. “We believe AI will be one of the most important technology transitions of our lifetime,” said Scott Chen, CEO and president of Kinsus. “After more than a decade of partnership with NVIDIA, we are excited to continue building the future together.” NVIDIA and Samsung Electro-Mechanics have amended their existing substrate supply agreement to improve operational capabilities at existing factories in support of increased production of NVIDIA’s accelerated computing platforms. The amendment builds on the companies’ previously announced multiyear collaboration supporting substrate manufacturing in Sejong and Busan, South Korea, for NVIDIA’s compute and high-speed networking technologies. “By combining our world-class substrate fine-processing technology and high-reliability MLCC technology, we will perfectly fulfill our role as a total solution provider so that NVIDIA’s AI platform can be supplied to the global market on time, with the highest performance and quality,” said Duck-Hyun Chang, CEO of Samsung Electro-Mechanics.   Scaling Advanced Packaging Through Multiyear Agreements NVIDIA’s advanced packaging plans include a new capacity expansion with SPIL and previously announced agreements supporting Amkor’s manufacturing expansion in the U.S. and South Korea. NVIDIA is supporting Amkor’s expansion of advanced packaging capacity in Arizona and South Korea through multiyear agreements announced in July and October 2026, totaling nearly $3 billion. The agreements include prepayments to help Amkor scale manufacturing capacity for NVIDIA’s long-term production needs. “Our agreements with NVIDIA support investments in Arizona and South Korea that will serve multiple generations of AI platforms,” said Kevin Engel, president and CEO of Amkor. “That long-term planning allows us to advance our packaging technologies and add manufacturing capacity as NVIDIA’s production needs grow.” NVIDIA and SPIL are expanding advanced packaging operations in Taiwan under a multiyear agreement supported by multibillion-dollar funding from NVIDIA. The expansion will increase contracted advanced packaging capacity dedicated to NVIDIA by mid-2029. The project includes new production lines with turnkey support spanning bumping, interposer wafer fabrication, assembly and testing. policyIdeas.title: 투자위축 대응형 구매확약·스케일업 보증
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 비R&D 금융·판로 사업으로 구매확약, 보증, 레퍼런스 확보를 묶어 민간 투자 공백을 완화
policyIdeas.why: AI·반도체 주가 변동성이 커지면 비상장 팹리스의 투자 유치와 고객 PoC가 동시에 지연될 수 있습니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 구매확약 금액, 보증 연계 금액, 후속 투자 유치, 고용 유지

policyIdeas.title: 국산 NPU 수요연계 실증·구매전환 바우처
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 비R&D 성격으로 수요기관의 PoC 비용, 클라우드 전환비, 성능검증, 초기 구매비를 패키지로 지원
policyIdeas.why: 국내 NPU 기업은 기술개발 이후 레퍼런스, 구매사례, 운영검증이 부족해 매출 전환이 지연됩니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 유료 전환 PoC 수, 구매계약 금액, 국산 NPU 사용 시간, 고객 재구매율

policyIdeas.title: AI 서비스 기업·NPU 기업 매칭형 마켓플레이스
policyIdeas.budgetItem: AI 서비스·SaaS·SI 기업이 국산 NPU에서 모델을 시험하고 견적을 비교할 수 있는 중개 플랫폼 운영
policyIdeas.why: 비R&D 사업은 기술 자체보다 수요 발굴과 거래비용 절감이 중요합니다. 시장 접점을 만들면 기업 간 매칭 속도가 올라갑니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 등록 수요기업 수, 매칭 건수, PoC 전환율, 상용 계약 전환율

policyIdeas.title: 국산 AI컴퓨팅 성능·전력 검증 인증제
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 민간 시험기관과 연계해 추론 성능, 전력효율, 호환성, 보안성을 검증하고 인증마크를 부여
policyIdeas.why: 구매자는 칩 홍보자료보다 제3자 검증 데이터를 요구합니다. 인증 체계는 조달·금융·해외진출의 공통 근거가 됩니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 인증 제품 수, 공개 벤치마크 수, 조달 등록 건수, 인증 기반 계약 금액

policyIdeas.title: K-엔비디아 기업 공동 데모룸·상설 쇼케이스
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 5개 NPU 기업의 제품을 공공·민간 수요자가 직접 비교 체험할 수 있는 상설 데모룸과 온라인 쇼케이스 운영
policyIdeas.why: 비R&D 사업은 수요자가 실제 성능과 적용 시나리오를 이해하도록 만드는 접점이 중요합니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 방문 수요기관 수, 데모 신청 건수, 후속 상담 건수, PoC 전환율

policyIdeas.title: 국산 NPU 도입 컨설팅·전환 설계 지원단
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 수요기업의 기존 GPU 워크로드를 진단하고 국산 NPU 적용 가능성, 비용, 전력, 전환 일정을 설계해주는 컨설팅 지원
policyIdeas.why: 수요기업은 국산 NPU를 쓰고 싶어도 모델 변환, 운영비 비교, 리스크 판단을 자체적으로 하기 어렵습니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 전환진단 보고서 수, 전환 가능 워크로드 수, 실제 PoC 착수율, 예상 비용 절감액

policyIdeas.title: AI반도체 현장전문인력 전환 교육
policyIdeas.budgetItem: AI 서비스 개발자, MLOps 담당자, 공공 정보화 담당자를 대상으로 NPU 모델 최적화·운영 교육 제공
policyIdeas.why: 칩 도입은 하드웨어 구매만으로 끝나지 않고 운영인력이 있어야 반복 사용과 확산이 가능합니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 교육 수료자 수, 기업별 적용 프로젝트 수, 모델 변환 성공률, 교육 후 PoC 착수율

policyIdeas.title: 온디바이스 AI 실증처 발굴 프로그램
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 제조, 보안, 모빌리티, 의료기기 분야에서 국산 NPU 모듈을 적용할 수요처를 발굴하고 실증 운영비 지원
policyIdeas.why: 데이터 외부 전송이 어렵거나 저전력이 중요한 분야는 국산 NPU가 차별화될 수 있는 초기 시장입니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 실증처 수, 제품 탑재 건수, 지연시간 개선, 전력 절감률

policyIdeas.title: 국산 NPU 기반 AI 데이터센터 전력절감 실증
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 공공·민간 데이터센터 일부 워크로드를 국산 NPU로 이전해 전력, 냉각, 비용 절감 효과를 검증
policyIdeas.why: AI 인프라 비용과 전력 문제가 커질수록 GPU 대체·보완재로서 국산 NPU의 정책 명분이 커집니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 전력 절감률, 랙당 처리량, 운영비 절감액, 전환 대상 워크로드 수

policyIdeas.title: 공공 AI서비스 국산 NPU 우선 실증 트랙
policyIdeas.budgetItem: 민원, 문서요약, 보안관제, 제조안전 등 공공 AI서비스에 국산 NPU 적용 가능성을 평가하는 운영비 지원
policyIdeas.why: 공공 부문은 초기 레퍼런스 시장을 열 수 있습니다. 단순 R&D 과제가 아니라 운영 워크로드 확보에 초점을 둬야 합니다.
policyIdeas.kpi: 공공 워크로드 수, 서비스 가동률, 비용 절감률, GPU 대비 전력 절감률

review.headline: 수출통제·AI컴퓨팅 안보, 파운드리·패키징 병목, AI 인프라 투자 신호를 중심으로, 신규 예산은 기술개발보다 수요 검증·운영 데이터·조달 전환을 강화하는 방향이 적절합니다.

sections.title: 정책수립 시사점
sections.body: 수출통제와 AI컴퓨팅 안보 신호가 강하면 국산 NPU 정책의 논리는 산업육성만이 아니라 안정적 조달과 국가 통제 가능한 AI 인프라 확보로 확장됩니다.
bullets: 해외 GPU 접근 리스크를 국산 AI컴퓨팅 도입 명분으로 정리
수출통제 대응 컨설팅과 조달 카탈로그를 함께 설계

sections.title: 시장·기술동향 판단
sections.body: AI 인프라 투자 확대와 공급망 재편은 국산 NPU에 기회지만, 실제 도입은 성능·전력·가격·운영 안정성 비교자료가 있어야 가능합니다.
bullets: 데이터센터 전력비와 추론비용 절감은 가장 설득력 있는 시장 진입 논리
온디바이스AI와 보안·금융 등 폐쇄망 수요는 해외 GPU 대비 차별화 가능성이 큼
파운드리·공급망 이슈는 국산 NPU 정책의 필요조건이지만, 구매전환을 보장하지는 않음

sections.title: 정부정책 방향
sections.body: 정부정책은 대체 컴퓨팅 확보와 보안검증을 묶어야 합니다. 단순 장비지원보다 공공기관이 실제로 사용할 수 있는 조달·보안·운영 기준을 만드는 것이 우선입니다.
bullets: 공공 폐쇄망 AI서비스 실증 트랙 신설
국산 NPU 보안성·공급 안정성 검증 리포트 발급
수출통제 리스크 진단과 대체 도입계획 컨설팅 지원

sections.title: 예산기획 체크포인트
sections.body: 우선 검토할 정책 아이템은 "투자위축 대응형 구매확약·스케일업 보증"입니다. 신규 예산은 제품 개발비보다 수요처 발굴, 실증 운영비, 성능검증, 구매전환 조건을 묶는 방향이 적합합니다.
bullets: 기업별 제품성숙도, 적용 가능 워크로드, 목표 수요처를 표준 양식으로 비교
시장 기사에서 반복되는 수요 분야를 공공 실증 후보 업무로 매핑
사업 공고에는 성능검증, 보안검증, 가격비교, 구매전환 조건을 필수 항목으로 포함
